Black paint, rounded stroke and proportional padded SVG viewport; original path data and transforms are unchanged.", "credit": "Will Pittenger; names corrected by Restu20", "historicalApplicability": "Full 5.245 km Mugello race loop, not the pit/paddock shortcut. svg.desc: Authentic source transforms applied; proportionally sampled route with subpixel curve tolerance; uniform black double contour with transparent center and background; no labels.
